isCapable.desc: Does the browser support the Screen Wake Lock API? Always 'false' on the server and, on SSR/SSG, until hydration completes

isActive.desc: Is a screen wake lock currently held? Becomes 'false' when the browser releases the lock on its own (page hidden, battery saver) and 'true' again once the plugin re-acquires it

request.desc: Keep the screen awake; the plugin re-acquires the lock whenever the browser drops it (page hidden) until release() is called

returns.desc: A Promise which is resolved when the wake lock is held. It gets rejected with 'Not capable' if the browser is not capable, and with the browser's DOMException (usually 'NotAllowedError': page hidden, battery saver, permissions policy) if the lock could not be acquired.

release.desc: Let the screen turn off again

returns.desc: A Promise which is resolved when the wake lock is released. It gets rejected with 'Not capable' if the browser is not capable.

toggle.desc: Request or release the wake lock, depending on whether one is currently held

returns.desc: A Promise which is resolved when the wake lock is acquired / released. It gets rejected with 'Not capable' if the browser is not capable, and with the browser's DOMException if the lock could not be acquired.
